decisions.reason: Having survived the first review while similar carpet variants were already culled, this carpet appears to fit the firm's existing materials and interior-design knowledge well enough that management would keep refining and positioning it rather than withdraw it soon.

The hand-knotted wool silk carpet draws strongly on the firm's premium-material and craftsmanship capabilities, so the firm is likely to use accumulated market feedback to improve sales and specification rather than exit within a year.

As a direct extension of the firm's core furniture and project-interior competence, the corner bench is highly learnable and commercially interpretable through existing channels, making near-term withdrawal unlikely.

The swivel shell chair line sits very close to the firm's established residential, workplace and public-interior expertise, and the multi-model format lets the firm adapt the range through feedback instead of dropping it.
